nodes.description: uint8 contract-level nonce used to seed pseudo random generation in Arena.
Public constant coin value (0.05 ETH) used for entry fee and payout calculation.
Constant delay in blocks before an Incoming gladiator becomes activatable.
Constant delay in blocks before an Outgoing gladiator can be removed.
Address of the Arena owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor.
Mapping of owner address to Gladiator struct holding state, transition block, position, weapon and coins.
10x10 grid of Tile structs (coins, weapon, gladiator) representing the Arena board.
Internal random helper using keccak256 of previous blockhash and pseudoRandomNonce modulo limit.
Constructor that assigns msg.sender as emperor.
Internal function initialising a gladiator in Incoming state with one coin and placing it on a tile.
Internal function that pays out coins via owner.transfer and then resets the gladiator state to Null.
Internal function adding coins to a tile's coin pool.
External payable entry point; takes coinValue from msg.sender and tries up to three random tile placements.
External function transitioning an Incoming gladiator to Active once its transition block has passed.
External function transitioning an Active gladiator to Outgoing and scheduling despawn.
External function that despawns an Outgoing gladiator and awards its coins.
Public function that increments the coin count of the zero-address gladiator slot.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal emperor (access control).
Modifier requiring the target gladiator state to be different from Null.
Modifier requiring the target gladiator to be in a specific GladiatorState.
Caller-controlled address used as owner identity for gladiators and as emperor check.
owner.transfer(gladiators[owner].coins * coinValue) external value transfer executed before state reset.
keccak256(block.blockhash(block.number-1), pseudoRandomNonce) % limit - weak miner-influenceable randomness.
(uint(0) - 1) arithmetic underflow used to represent max int as the active state transition block.
Parameter of pseudoRandomUint8 bounding the random result.
x coordinate parameter of startGladiatorWithCoin.
y coordinate parameter of startGladiatorWithCoin.
owner parameter of startGladiatorWithCoin.
owner parameter of despawnGladiatorAndAwardCoins used for the payout transfer.
x coordinate parameter of addCoins.
y coordinate parameter of addCoins.
amount parameter of addCoins added to the tile coin pool.
Target gladiator address parameter of activateGladiator.
Loop counter i in throwIn's three-iteration placement loop.
Randomly generated x candidate written to tiles in throwIn.
Randomly generated y candidate written to tiles in throwIn.
Last candidate x retained for the fallback addCoins call.
Last candidate y retained for the fallback addCoins call.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender to the emperor state variable, granting privileged role to the deployer.
Arena constructor writes msg.sender into emperor.
onlyEmporer modifier requires msg.sender == emperor before executing the guarded function.
emperor state variable is read during the onlyEmporer require check.
throwIn uses msg.sender as the gladiator owner and pays entry fee on its behalf.
imOut keys the gladiators mapping with msg.sender.
getOut passes msg.sender into despawnGladiatorAndAwardCoins as payout recipient.
throwIn requires msg.value to equal the coinValue constant.
Payout transfer multiplies gladiator coins by the coinValue constant.
throwIn calls pseudoRandomUint8 to pick candidate coordinates.
throwIn calls startGladiatorWithCoin when an empty tile is found.
throwIn calls addCoins in the fallback branch when no free tile exists.
throwIn reads tiles[x][y].gladiator to test tile occupancy.
throwIn requires the caller's gladiator state to be Null before entry.
pseudoRandomUint8 reads pseudoRandomNonce as hashing seed and increments it.
pseudoRandomUint8 computes the weak keccak256/blockhash randomness expression.
startGladiatorWithCoin writes state, transition block, position and coins into gladiators.
startGladiatorWithCoin writes the owner address into tiles[x][y].gladiator.
spawnTime constant is added to block.number to compute stateTransitionBlock.
despawnGladiatorAndAwardCoins performs the external value transfer to the gladiator owner.
The owner parameter is the recipient of the external transfer.
External transfer to owner happens before gladiators[owner].state is reset to Null, allowing state-visible callback/re-entry.
getOut invokes the payout routine after checking the Outgoing transition block.
getOut reads gladiators[msg.sender].stateTransitionBlock before despawn.
imOut writes Outgoing state and next transition block into gladiators.
despawnTime constant is added to block.number when scheduling despawn.
activateGladiator writes Active state and transition block into gladiators[who].
activateGladiator assigns (uint(0) - 1), an underflow used as max int sentinel.
The who parameter selects the gladiator entry written by activateGladiator.
activateGladiator applies the gladiatorExists modifier.
activateGladiator applies the gladiatorInState(Incoming) modifier.
getOut applies the gladiatorInState(Outgoing) modifier.
imOut applies the gladiatorInState(Active) modifier.
gladiatorExists reads gladiators[owner].state to test for Null.
gladiatorInState reads gladiators[owner].state against the expected state.
nextBlock increments gladiators[0x0].coins without bounds checking.
limit parameter is used as the modulo divisor in pseudoRandomUint8.
start_x parameter becomes the gladiator x coordinate and tile index.
start_y parameter becomes the gladiator y coordinate and tile index.
start_owner parameter keys the gladiators mapping entry.
despawn_owner parameter selects the gladiator whose coins are paid out and re-keys the mapping.
addCoins_x parameter indexes the tiles array's first dimension.
addCoins_y parameter indexes the tiles array's second dimension.
addCoins_amount parameter is added to tiles[x][y].coins without overflow checking.
throwIn_i loop counter bounds the three-iteration random placement loop.
throwIn_x local is used to index tiles and startGladiatorWithCoin.
throwIn_y local is used to index tiles and startGladiatorWithCoin.
throwIn_lastX carries the last candidate x into the fallback addCoins call.
throwIn_lastY carries the last candidate y into the fallback addCoins call.

normalization_plan.reason: The limit parameter only exists to bound the internal random helper's modulo and has no independent semantics outside that function.
Coordinate parameter is immediately stored into the gladiator struct and tile grid by its owning function.
Coordinate parameter is immediately stored into the gladiator struct and tile grid by its owning function.
Owner parameter is only used as the mapping key for the newly created gladiator.
Owner parameter drives the payout transfer and mapping reset performed by this function.
Tile index parameter is only meaningful inside the addCoins function body.
Tile index parameter is only meaningful inside the addCoins function body.
Amount parameter is only used in the tile coin summation performed by addCoins.
Target address parameter is only used to select and update a gladiator entry inside activateGladiator.
Local loop counter has scope limited to throwIn's placement loop.
Local random x candidate is consumed entirely within throwIn.
Local random y candidate is consumed entirely within throwIn.
Local retains the last candidate x solely for throwIn's fallback branch.
Local retains the last candidate y solely for throwIn's fallback branch.
